intake.summary: Current analysis indicates the need for improvements. Ensure coverage delta is positive by improving test coverage or test quality. Boost the mutation score above baseline by optimizing tests to detect mutations.

generate.draft: To achieve a positive coverage delta and improve the mutation score above baseline, focus on the following strategies: 1) Identify critical areas of the codebase with low coverage and write additional tests to ensure they are adequately covered. 2) Refactor existing tests to enhance their efficiency and ensure they are effectively targeting potential mutants. 3) Utilize mutation testing tools to identify weak spots in the test suite and address them by developing robust test cases. 4) Encourage pair programming and code reviews to generate broader test scenarios and catch edge cases. By concentrating efforts on these areas, the enhanced test suite should help achieve the desired coverage delta and mutation score improvements.

args.command: echo Calculate the current coverage delta
echo Calculate the current mutation score
echo Determine the baseline mutation score
